title: Charger Cables Have A Lump That Stops Them Broadcasting

scenes.narration: There is a hard lump molded around your laptop charger cable, and it is surprisingly heavy for its size.
scenes.note: Weight sells it. Bill should feel the mass, not just see the shape.

beats.action: a charger cable snakes across a desk; Bill picks up the moulded lump
the lump circles teal; camera punches in
the cable dips under the lump; a small weight mark drops beside it
Bill turns the lump over, weighing it in his palm
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: Inside it is a ring of ferrite, an iron-based ceramic.
scenes.note: Open it up. A ring around the wire, nothing more complicated than that.

beats.action: the plastic shell peels away in cross-section
a dark ceramic ring is revealed encircling the cable, labelled

scenes.narration: A power cable is a long piece of wire, and a long piece of wire is an antenna, so it picks up and radiates high-frequency noise it was never meant to carry.
scenes.note: THE idea of the episode: wire equals antenna. Broadcast waves need to look like a nuisance.

beats.action: the cable straightens into a plain horizontal wire on a schematic field
the wire redraws as an aerial; broadcast arcs radiate off it
jagged high-frequency squiggles run along the wire in coral
the arcs reach a nearby radio icon, which fuzzes
the broadcast arcs pulse outward again, wider
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the radio icon fuzzes harder as the arcs strengthen
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The ferrite ring lets your actual power pass straight through, and turns that noise into a tiny amount of heat.
scenes.note: Selectivity is the mechanism: power passes, noise does not. Show BOTH signals meeting the ring.

beats.action: the ferrite ring drops onto the wire
a smooth low-frequency wave passes straight through the ring untouched
the jagged noise hits the ring, is absorbed, and radiates off as small heat marks
more noise arrives at the ring and is absorbed
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: It is a filter wrapped around a cable, stopping your charger from transmitting.
scenes.note: Return to the desk. The radio clears. End on the object.

beats.action: the ring settles back inside its plastic shell on the real cable
the broadcast arcs cut out; the radio icon clears; hard cut
the plastic shell closes back over the ring
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap
